sqlquery.from: ( SELECT e.id as eid, max(e.subject) as subject, max(e.description) as description, max(r.toname) as candidateName, max(e.startDate) as startDate, max(e.endDate) as endDate, array_to_string(array_agg(coalesce(mu.firstname,'')||' '||coalesce(mu.lastname,'')), ', ') as assignees, max(e.activitytype) as type, max(coalesce(m.firstname,'')||' '||coalesce(m.lastname,'')) as owner, max(e.creationtime) as creationdate FROM "$".relation r LEFT JOIN "$".event e ON (e.id = r.fromID) LEFT JOIN "$".myuser m ON (m.id = e.owner) LEFT JOIN "$".employeeevent ee ON (ee.event_id = e.id) LEFT JOIN "$".myuser mu ON (mu.id = ee.employee_id) WHERE r.toType = 'candidate' and r.fromType = 'event' AND (ee.shared is true OR ee.edit is true) AND (e.deleted is not true) AND (ee.deleted is not true) AND (mu.deleted is not true) GROUP BY eid ORDER BY e.startDate ) t
